proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly distinguishes an ll extension of śuṣka and cites Oriya sukhilā dried/withered alongside Torwali šugil. These western and central survey sūkh-l/hūk-l adjectives preserve both the dry stem and the l expansion, with ordinary final vowels and western s-to-h outcomes. Compound gone/dried expressions, separate copulas and prefix-bearing forms are excluded; this is a comparative extension-family link, not a detailed reconstruction of every local ending.
